# ColorPalette

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Tailwind v4 colour ramps addressed by shade, e.g. `ColorPalette.red[500]`.

This is the single home for the palette tokens — `Color` is just the RGBA primitive and no longer carries `red500` etc. The values are the exact published Tailwind swatches and are **not** computed: Tailwind's ramps are hand-tuned in OKLCH and cannot be reproduced by lightening or darkening a single base colour, so storing the real values (rather than a formula) is what keeps the swatches accurate.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.
